subject: DI03009021

body.en:
Definition

A captive plant generates electricity primarily for the use of its owner or designated captive users;legal qualification depends on applicable ownership/consumption rules,not merely being located in a factory.

Explanation and application

  • Captive plants may use diesel,gas,biomass,renewables or cogeneration. A standby DG set describes duty;it is not a universal legal definition of captive power.
  • In a DG set,fuel chemical energy→combustion heat/pressure→engine shaft work→alternator electrical energy. Diesel ignition is by compression-heated air,not a spark plug in the normal diesel cycle.
  • Advantages:compact/modular units,short start time relative to steam plants,local backup and comparatively low initial cost for small duties.
  • Limitations:fuel and maintenance cost,noise/vibration,exhaust emissions,fire risks and poor light-load performance. Fuel storage,ventilation and emissions compliance are essential.
DGvoltage versus frequency controls?

AVR controls excitation/voltage;governor controls engine speed/fuel.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Captive plant મુખ્યત્વે owner/designated captive users માટે વીજળી બનાવે;legal qualification applicable ownership/consumption rules મુજબ હોય,માત્ર factoryમાં હોવાને કારણે નહીં.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Captive plant diesel,gas,biomass,renewables કે cogeneration વાપરી શકે.Standby DG set duty બતાવે,captive powerની universal legal definition નહીં.
  • DG setમાં fuel chemical energy→combustion heat/pressure→engine shaft work→alternator electrical energy.સામાન્ય diesel cycleમાં compressionથી ગરમ air ignition કરે,spark plug નહીં.
  • ફાયદા:compact/modular units,steam plant કરતાં short start time,local backup તથા small duty માટે comparatively low initial cost.
  • મર્યાદા:fuel/maintenance cost,noise/vibration,exhaust emission,fire risk તથા poor light-load performance. Fuel storage,ventilation/emission compliance જરૂરી.
DG voltage/frequency controls?

AVR excitation/voltage;governor engine speed/fuel ગોઠવે.

body.en:
Definition

A diesel generating set combines a compression-ignition engine,alternator and supporting systems to deliver electrical power at specified voltage,frequency and duty.

Classification / representative type

  • Standby,prime and continuous ratings have different permitted duties;single/three-phase and open/acoustic arrangements are separate classifications.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Engine cylinder,piston,crankshaft and fuel-injection equipment convert fuel energy into shaft rotation.
  2. Air filter,intake and exhaust system support breathing;exhaust silencing and safe routing limit noise and harmful exposure.
  3. Lubrication and cooling circuits reduce friction and keep temperatures within the rated envelope.
  4. Alternator,exciter and AVR control electrical conversion and voltage;governor controls engine speed/fuel rather than directly changing transformer ratio.
  5. Starting battery/starter,base frame,anti-vibration supports and compatible acoustic/ventilation enclosure provide auxiliary functions.
  6. Control panel,protective devices and approved transfer/synchronising equipment prevent unsafe backfeed and manage the intended operating mode.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. The starter cranks the engine;air enters and is compressed to a high temperature.
  2. Fuel injection near the end of compression causes combustion;gas expansion pushes the piston.
  3. Connecting rod/crankshaft turn piston motion into continuous shaft rotation and drive the alternator.
  4. Alternator excitation and speed establish usable voltage/frequency;controls permit connection only in the approved operating state.
  5. As load increases,the governor raises fuel input within rating;AVR adjusts excitation to support voltage.
  6. Protection responds to low oil pressure,overtemperature,overspeed and electrical faults;controlled shutdown/cooling follows manufacturer requirements.

Applications

Emergency supply and local captive power with rated fuel,load and environmental provisions.

Limitations and safety

DG exhaust contains lethal carbon monoxide;never run a combustion set indoors or connect it to a wall socket. Student work is diagram/model based,not starting or transfer-switch wiring.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Diesel generating set compression-ignition engine,alternator/supporting systemsથી specified voltage,frequency/duty પર electrical power આપે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Standby,prime/continuous ratingsના permitted duties અલગ છે;single/three-phase તથા open/acoustic અલગ classifications છે.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Engine cylinder,piston,crankshaft/fuel injection fuel energyને shaft rotationમાં ફેરવે.
  2. Air filter,intake/exhaust breathingમાં મદદ કરે;silencing/safe routing noise/harmful exposure ઘટાડે.
  3. Lubrication/cooling circuits friction ઘટાડે તથા temperatures rated envelopeમાં રાખે.
  4. Alternator,exciter/AVR electrical conversion/voltage સંભાળે;governor engine speed/fuel ગોઠવે,transformer ratio નહીં.
  5. Starting battery/starter,base frame,anti-vibration supports/compatible acoustic-ventilation enclosure auxiliary functions આપે.
  6. Control panel,protection/approved transfer-synchronising equipment unsafe backfeed અટકાવી intended mode સંભાળે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Starter engine crank કરે;air પ્રવેશે/compress થઈ high temperature થાય.
  2. Compression અંત પાસે fuel injectionથી combustion થાય;gas expansion piston ધકેલે.
  3. Connecting rod/crankshaft piston motionને shaft rotationમાં ફેરવી alternator ચલાવે.
  4. Alternator excitation/speed usable voltage/frequency બનાવે;controls approved stateમાં જ connection આપે.
  5. Load વધે ત્યારે governor ratingમાં fuel input વધારે;AVR voltage માટે excitation ગોઠવે.
  6. Low oil pressure,overtemperature,overspeed/electrical fault પર protection કામ કરે;shutdown/cooling manufacturer મુજબ હોય.

ઉપયોગ

Rated fuel,load/environmental provisions સાથે emergency/local captive supply.

મર્યાદા અને સલામતી

DG exhaustમાં ઘાતક carbon monoxide હોય;ઘરમાં combustion set ચલાવવું કે wall socketમાં જોડવું નહીં.Student work diagram/model છે,starting/transfer wiring નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Power factor relates real power to apparent power:pf=P/S;engine kW capability and alternator kVA/current capability must both be satisfied.

Explanation and application

  • Assume a100kVAset rated0.8pf:nominal real capacity80kW. A60kWload at0.75pf requires80kVA;both ratings appear adequate on steady-state arithmetic alone.
  • Motor starting,step load,temperature/altitude derating,nonlinear loads and allowable voltage/frequency dip may demand a different size;nameplate division alone is not final selection.
  • Assume60kWoutput,15kg/hfuel and42MJ/kgCV. Fuel input=15×42/3.6=175kW;efficiency=60/175=34.286%.Specific fuel consumption=15/60=0.25kg/kWh.
  • The3.6factor converts MJ/h to kW;do not divide by3600without also converting MJto kJor J. All values are teaching assumptions.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Power factor real/apparent powerનો સંબંધ pf=P/S છે;engine kW capability તથા alternator kVA/current બંને સંતોષવા જોઈએ.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • 100kVA set rated0.8pf ધારો:nominal real capacity80kW.60kW load at0.75pf માટે80kVA જોઈએ;માત્ર steady-state arithmeticમાં બંને ratings adequate લાગે.
  • Motor starting,step load,temperature/altitude derating,nonlinear loads/allowable voltage-frequency dipથી size બદલાય;માત્ર nameplate division final selection નથી.
  • 60kW output,15kg/h fuel તથા42MJ/kg CV ધારો.Fuel input=15×42/3.6=175kW;efficiency=60/175=34.286%.Specific fuel consumption=15/60=0.25kg/kWh.
  • 3.6factor MJ/hને kWમાં ફેરવે;MJને kJ/Jમાં ફેરવ્યા વિના3600થી નભાગો.બધા values teaching assumptions છે.

body.en:
Definition

Anaerobic digestion is microbial decomposition of suitable organic material without oxygen,producing biogas and digestate;biogas is a fuel,not electricity by itself.

Classification / representative type

  • Biochemical conversion includes anaerobic digestion;it differs from combustion,gasification and chemical biodiesel production.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Feed reception,sorting and slurry preparation remove unsuitable contaminants and establish a processable mixture.
  2. Asealed digester provides controlled retention,mixing and temperature appropriate to microbial conversion.
  3. Gas holder,pressure relief and authorised piping manage biogas;leak detection and ventilation control fire/asphyxiation risks.
  4. Gas cleaning removes moisture and harmful contaminants such as hydrogen sulphide to the engine specification.
  5. Biogas-compatible engine-generator and electrical controls convert gas fuel into electricity;heat recovery may support useful combined heat and power.
  6. Digestate handling,treatment and permitted utilisation/disposal manage remaining material rather than discharging it untreated.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Prepared biodegradable feed enters the digester under controlled process conditions.
  2. Microbial stages break organic matter down and methane-forming organisms produce combustible biogas.
  3. Collected gas is dried/cleaned and buffered to meet the generator fuel requirements.
  4. The gas engine converts fuel energy to shaft work and drives the alternator.
  5. Electrical controls deliver protected output;recovered heat can serve the process only where suitable.
  6. Digestate and emissions are managed under applicable approvals;feedstock variability affects gas yield and output.

Applications

Sewage/agricultural/organic-waste energy recovery after feedstock and environmental assessment.

Limitations and safety

Methane is flammable and H2Scan be lethal. No gas generation,storage,flame test or digester entry by students;use a dry illustrative model.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Anaerobic digestion oxygen વિના suitable organic materialનું microbial decomposition છે,જે biogas/digestate આપે;biogas fuel છે,પોતે વીજળી નહીં.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Biochemical conversionમાં anaerobic digestion આવે;તે combustion,gasification/chemical biodiesel productionથી અલગ છે.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Feed reception,sorting/slurry preparation unsuitable contaminants દૂર કરી processable mixture બનાવે.
  2. Sealed digester microbial conversion માટે યોગ્ય retention,mixing/temperature આપે.
  3. Gas holder,pressure relief/authorised piping biogas સંભાળે;leak detection/ventilation fire-asphyxiation risks નિયંત્રિત કરે.
  4. Gas cleaning moisture તથા hydrogen sulphide જેવા harmful contaminants engine specification મુજબ દૂર કરે.
  5. Biogas-compatible engine-generator/controls gas fuelને વીજળીમાં ફેરવે;heat recoveryથી useful combined heat/power મળી શકે.
  6. Digestate handling,treatment/permitted use-disposal બાકી material સંભાળે;untreated છોડાતું નથી.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Prepared biodegradable feed controlled conditionsમાં digesterમાં જાય.
  2. Microbial stages organic matter તોડે;methane-forming organisms combustible biogas બનાવે.
  3. Collected gasને dry/clean/buffer કરી generator fuel requirement પૂરી થાય.
  4. Gas engine fuel energyને shaft workમાં ફેરવી alternator ચલાવે.
  5. Electrical controls protected output આપે;યોગ્ય હોય ત્યાં recovered heat processમાં વપરાય.
  6. Digestate/emissions applicable approval હેઠળ સંભાળાય;feedstock variability gas yield/output બદલે.

ઉપયોગ

Feedstock/environmental assessment બાદ sewage/agricultural/organic-waste energy recovery.

મર્યાદા અને સલામતી

Methane flammable/H2S ઘાતક હોઈ શકે.વિદ્યાર્થી gas generation/storage,flame test કે digester entry નકરે;dry illustrative model લો.

body.en:
Definition

Thermo-chemical conversion uses heat-driven processes such as combustion,gasification or pyrolysis to convert suitable feedstock;municipal-waste power needs segregated,characterised material and emission control.

Classification / representative type

  • The illustrated route is controlled combustion with steam generation;gasification produces fuel gas and pyrolysis produces varying gas/liquid/char products,so their layouts differ.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Waste reception,segregation and preprocessing remove noncombustible/incompatible fractions and prepare the specified feed.
  2. Acontrolled furnace and feeding system sustain suitable temperature,residence and mixing conditions,not open burning.
  3. Boiler heating surfaces recover combustion heat to produce steam;corrosion/fouling influence material selection and maintenance.
  4. Steam turbine,alternator,condenser and feedwater system perform electrical conversion and working-fluid recirculation.
  5. Flue-gas cleaning,monitoring and engineered stack control particulates and other regulated pollutants.
  6. Bottom ash and air-pollution-control residues are separately characterised and managed in authorised routes;they are not automatically harmless fertiliser.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Suitable prepared waste enters the controlled furnace;moisture and calorific value affect stable combustion.
  2. Combustion releases heat and flue gas;engineered conditions minimise incomplete combustion.
  3. Boiler recovers heat and produces steam at the specified operating state.
  4. Steam expansion drives the turbine-generator;condenser/feed pump close the water cycle.
  5. Gas-cleaning equipment treats emissions before monitored discharge.
  6. Residues are safely handled;auxiliaries consume some gross power and seasonal waste composition changes output.

Applications

Controlled recovery from suitable residual waste after waste-hierarchy and feasibility assessment.

Limitations and safety

No student waste burning,gasification or chemical emission testing;do not equate renewable biomass fraction with all plastics in mixed waste.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Thermo-chemical conversionમાં suitable feedstock માટે combustion,gasification/pyrolysis જેવા heat-driven processes વપરાય;municipal-waste power માટે segregated,characterised material/emission control જોઈએ.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • દર્શાવેલો route controlled combustion/steam generation છે;gasification fuel gas અને pyrolysis gas/liquid/char આપે,તેમના layouts અલગ છે.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Waste reception,segregation/preprocessing noncombustible/incompatible fractions દૂર કરી specified feed બનાવે.
  2. Controlled furnace/feeding system યોગ્ય temperature,residence/mixing જાળવે;open burning નહીં.
  3. Boiler heating surfacesથી combustion heat recover કરી steam બને;corrosion/fouling material selection/maintenanceને અસર કરે.
  4. Steam turbine,alternator,condenser/feedwater system electrical conversion/working-fluid recirculation કરે.
  5. Flue-gas cleaning,monitoring/engineered stack particulates તથા regulated pollutants નિયંત્રિત કરે.
  6. Bottom ash/air-pollution-control residues અલગ characterise/authorised routesમાં સંભાળાય;તે આપોઆપ harmless fertiliser નથી.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Suitable prepared waste furnaceમાં જાય;moisture/calorific value stable combustionને અસર કરે.
  2. Combustion heat/flue gas આપે;engineered conditions incomplete combustion ઘટાડે.
  3. Boiler heat recover કરી specified state પર steam બનાવે.
  4. Steam expansion turbine-generator ચલાવે;condenser/feed pump water cycle પૂર્ણ કરે.
  5. Gas-cleaning equipment monitored discharge પહેલાં emissions treat કરે.
  6. Residues safely સંભાળાય;auxiliaries gross powerનો ભાગ લે અને seasonal waste composition output બદલે.

ઉપયોગ

Waste-hierarchy/feasibility assessment બાદ suitable residual wasteમાંથી controlled recovery.

મર્યાદા અને સલામતી

Student waste burning,gasification/chemical emission testing નહીં.Mixed wasteના plasticsને renewable biomass fraction નમાનો.

h.en: Agro-based biodiesel route and biomass fuel forms
h.gu: Agro-based Biodiesel route તથા Biomass fuel forms

body.en:
Definition

Biodiesel is a mixture of fatty-acid alkyl esters produced from suitable oils/fats;it differs from raw vegetable oil and fossil diesel. The syllabus agro-chemical label refers here to agro-based chemical fuel conversion.

Explanation and application

  • Layout:oil-bearing crop/waste-oil receipt→oil extraction or collection→pretreatment→authorised transesterification→separation/purification→quality-tested biodiesel→compatible engine-generator. Glycerol-rich coproduct and wastewater need separate management.
  • Working:chemical processing converts triglycerides into esters;purification removes residues and testing verifies fuel specification. The compatible engine then burns the fuel to produce shaft work and electrical output;the chemical reactor itself is not an alternator.
  • Solid biomass:wood,bagasse and crop residues need moisture,size,ash and handling assessment;low bulk density may raise transport/storage costs.
  • Liquid biomass-derived fuel:ethanol,biodiesel and some bio-oils have different viscosity,corrosion,storage and engine-compatibility requirements;they cannot be substituted without approval.
  • Gaseous fuel:biogas and producer gas differ in composition,heating value and contaminants;gas cleaning,leak protection and correct fuel equipment are essential.
  • Biomass is renewable only within sustainable supply assumptions;land/water use,food competition,transport and emissions must be assessed. No student alcohol/catalyst handling or fuel synthesis.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Biodiesel suitable oils/fatsમાંથી બનેલા fatty-acid alkyl estersનું mixture છે;raw vegetable oil/fossil dieselથી અલગ છે.Syllabusનું agro-chemical label અહીં agro-based chemical fuel conversion દર્શાવે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Layout:oil-bearing crop/waste-oil receipt→oil extraction/collection→pretreatment→authorised transesterification→separation/purification→quality-tested biodiesel→compatible engine-generator. Glycerol-rich coproduct/wastewater અલગ સંભાળાય.
  • Working:chemical processing triglyceridesને estersમાં ફેરવે;purification residues દૂર કરે/testing fuel specification ચકાસે.Compatible engine fuel બાળી shaft work/electric output આપે;chemical reactor alternator નથી.
  • Solid biomass:wood,bagasse/crop residues માટે moisture,size,ash/handling તપાસો;low bulk densityથી transport/storage cost વધે.
  • Liquid biomass-derived fuel:ethanol,biodiesel તથા કેટલાક bio-oilsનાં viscosity,corrosion,storage/engine-compatibility અલગ છે;approval વિના interchange નહીં.
  • Gaseous fuel:biogas/producer gas composition,heating value/contaminantsમાં અલગ;gas cleaning,leak protection/correct equipment જરૂરી.
  • Sustainable supply હોય ત્યારે biomass renewable કહેવાય;land/water use,food competition,transport/emissions તપાસો.Student alcohol/catalyst handling કે fuel synthesis નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A fuel cell is an electrochemical device that continuously converts the chemical energy of externally supplied fuel and oxidant into electrical energy,heat and reaction products.

Classification / representative type

  • Types by electrolyte include PEMFC,AFC,PAFC,MCFCand SOFC. The illustrated hydrogen PEMcell is a representative type,not the chemistry of every fuel cell.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Anode receives hydrogen through flow channels and a catalyst promotes oxidation.
  2. Cathode receives oxygen/air and catalyst supports the reduction reaction.
  3. Proton-exchange membrane carries protons but blocks electrons and separates gases in the representative PEM design.
  4. Gas-diffusion layers and current collectors distribute reactants and collect current.
  5. Seals,water/thermal management and reactant supply maintain safe operating conditions and membrane performance.
  6. Stacked cells raise usable voltage;DCconditioning/inverter and protection match the output to the intended load.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. At the PEM anode:H2→2H⁺+2e⁻.Hydrogen is electrochemically oxidised rather than burned in a turbine.
  2. Protons cross the membrane while electrons travel through the external load,providing DC current.
  3. At the cathode:½O2+2H⁺+2e⁻→H2O;water and heat are produced.
  4. Overall:H2+½O2→H2O. The external electron path is essential;shorting collectors bypasses useful load work.
  5. Continuous reactant supply sustains output unlike a closed stored-reactant battery;individual cell voltage is low,so series stacks are used.
  6. Controls manage temperature,water and reactant flows;power electronics provide compatible output without mechanical rotation in the cell itself.

Applications

Stationary backup,distributed generation and transport with suitable fuel infrastructure.

Limitations and safety

Hydrogen fire/pressure and chemical hazards require certified equipment;students use drawings or approved sealed educational devices only.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Fuel cell electrochemical device છે,જે externally supplied fuel/oxidantની chemical energyને સતત electrical energy,heat/reaction productsમાં ફેરવે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Electrolyte મુજબ PEMFC,AFC,PAFC,MCFC/SOFC types છે.દર્શાવેલી hydrogen PEM cell representative છે,બધી fuel cellsનું chemistry નહીં.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Anodeને flow channelsથી hydrogen મળે;catalyst oxidationમાં મદદ કરે.
  2. Cathodeને oxygen/air મળે;catalyst reductionમાં મદદ કરે.
  3. Representative PEM designમાં membrane protons વહન કરે,electrons રોકે તથા gases અલગ રાખે.
  4. Gas-diffusion layers/current collectors reactants વહેંચે અને current collect કરે.
  5. Seals,water/thermal management તથા reactant supply safe conditions/membrane performance જાળવે.
  6. Stacked cells usable voltage વધારે;DC conditioning/inverter/protection load સાથે output મેળવે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. PEM anode પર:H2→2H⁺+2e⁻.Hydrogen electrochemical oxidation કરે,turbineમાં બાળાતો નથી.
  2. Protons membrane પાર કરે,electrons external loadમાંથી જઈ DC current આપે.
  3. Cathode પર:½O2+2H⁺+2e⁻→H2O;water/heat બને.
  4. Overall:H2+½O2→H2O. External electron path જરૂરી;collectors short કરતાં useful load work bypass થાય.
  5. Continuous reactant supplyથી output ચાલુ રહે;closed stored-reactant batteryથી અલગ છે.Cell voltage ઓછું હોવાથી series stack વપરાય.
  6. Controls temperature,water/reactant flow સંભાળે;power electronics compatible output આપે.Cell પોતે mechanically ફરતી નથી.

ઉપયોગ

Suitable fuel infrastructure સાથે stationary backup,distributed generation/transport.

મર્યાદા અને સલામતી

Hydrogen fire/pressure/chemical hazards માટે certified equipment જોઈએ;વિદ્યાર્થી drawings કે approved sealed educational devices જ વાપરે.

body.en:
Definition

Electrolyte and charge carrier distinguish fuel-cell families and influence temperature,fuel tolerance,startup and materials.

Explanation and application

  • PEMFCuses a proton-exchange membrane;AFCuses an alkaline electrolyte and hydroxide transport;PAFCuses phosphoric acid. MCFCuses molten carbonate and carbonate-ion transport;SOFCuses a solid oxide electrolyte and typically oxygen-ion transport.
  • Low-temperature PEM designs suit comparatively rapid startup but demand suitable fuel purity;high-temperature MCFC/SOFCsystems offer heat integration and different fuel processing,with thermal/material challenges.
  • Advantages:direct electrochemical conversion,quiet operation,modularity and useful heat recovery where suitable. Hydrogen cells emit water at point of use,but hydrogen production can carry emissions.
  • Limitations:cost,catalyst/material durability,fuel processing/purity,reactant infrastructure and balance-of-plant complexity. Fuel cells are not free energy or automatically carbon-free over their lifecycle.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Electrolyte/charge carrierથી fuel-cell families અલગ પડે;temperature,fuel tolerance,startup/materials પર અસર થાય.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • PEMFC proton-exchange membrane,AFC alkaline electrolyte/hydroxide transport તથા PAFC phosphoric acid વાપરે.MCFC molten carbonate/carbonate-ion અને SOFC solid oxide electrolyte/સામાન્ય oxygen-ion transport વાપરે.
  • Low-temperature PEM comparatively rapid startup આપે પણ fuel purity જોઈએ;high-temperature MCFC/SOFC heat integration/different fuel processing આપે,સાથે thermal/material challenges છે.
  • ફાયદા:direct electrochemical conversion,quiet operation,modularity/યોગ્ય heat recovery. Hydrogen cell point-of-use water આપે,પણ hydrogen productionમાં emissions હોઈ શકે.
  • મર્યાદા:cost,catalyst/material durability,fuel processing/purity,infrastructure/balance-of-plant complexity. Fuel cell free energy કે આપોઆપ lifecycle carbon-free નથી.
